name: AI/ML API
short: Single-key gateway to 10,000+ AI models and agentic tools (500+ AI models from 70+ providers), with volume discounts and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Zero markup on any request - pay the same price as going direct. The free tier is currently paused: the help-center FAQ says "We do not offer free models at the moment" (2026-03-25), though the pricing page header still advertises a "free playground tier".

plans.name: No free tier (paused)
plans.notes: Help-center FAQ (updated 2026-03-25): "We do not offer free models at the moment." The pricing page header still advertises a "free playground tier", but the playground requires a paid top-up (from $20; card/PayPal/crypto); top-up credits never expire. No published rate limits.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: One billing key for every provider; zero markup — pay the same price as going direct to the provider. Per-model rates vary; see the pricing page for current per-1M-token input/output prices (e.g. Beam 1.0 501B A23B $0.2645/$1.058, GLM-5.3 $1.4/$4.4 per the live table).
